visualCharacteristics.purpose: Onward/support link tiles: optional icon, bold title, short muted description, CTA with circled arrow
notes: Column count follows the tile count (2 -> 2 columns, 3 -> 3, 4 -> 4 on desktop; 1 column on mobile).
Tiles separated by thin #cfd5d3 rules like cards-features.
Optional ~40px icon above the title; whole tile clickable via the single CTA link.

contentPattern.structure: one row per tile; cell 1 = icon image (may be empty), cell 2 = richtext (h3 title + p description + p>a CTA)

text: p > a: Go to Help & FAQs →

usage: Home page 'Need support?' tiles and the shared 'Explore more in the Content Shop' section on campaign pages.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for 1-4 short onward-navigation tiles, each with one link; works on paper and white sections.

blockStructure.notes: One row per tile; empty icon cell must still be included. A trailing arrow in the link text is optional (one is added).
